create_cpu_adam_optimizer: create a CPUAdam optimizer instance with custom learning rate, betas, and weight decay parameters
configure_fairseq_cpu_adam: configure FairseqCPUAdamConfig dataclass with adam_betas, epsilon, weight_decay, and fp16 stats settings
run_cpu_adam_step: run an optimization step on CPUAdam optimizer to update model parameters using DeepSpeed Adam
review_fairseqcpuadam_optimizer_config: review the FairseqCPUAdam optimizer_config property that returns overridable kwargs for checkpoint resumption
test_get_cpu_adam: test the _get_cpu_adam function to load DeepSpeed CPUAdamBuilder or fbcode DeepSpeedCPUAdam fallback
